infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Scooby's Kitchen needs camera access to let you take photos of your pet, scan recipes, and be seen during video consultations with the veterinarian.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Scooby's Kitchen needs microphone access so you can speak during your video consultation with the veterinarian.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Scooby's Kitchen needs access to your photo library so you can upload a profile picture and photos of your pet.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Scooby's Kitchen uses your location to auto-fill your delivery address at checkout.

plugins.savePhotosPermission: Scooby's Kitchen needs permission to save your Pet Heritage Passport to your photo library.
